按逐日结算权益计算，是统计值而不是账本数值。年化按这些交易日跨越的日历时间折算，: Computed from day-end settlement equity; statistics, not ledger values. Yearly figures are scaled by the calendar time these trading days span, with a zero risk-free rate, and are not computed for fewer than 20 trading days.

主力连续 · 每个交易日取当时主力月份的 K 线，收盘价按换月比例调整到最新月份: Dominant series · each trading day reads the bars of the month that is dominant then, with closes scaled by the roll ratios to the level of the latest month
排序规则每侧持有 {held} 个，至少需要 {need} 个合约或主力连续；当: A ranking rule holds {held} a side and needs at least {need} contracts or dominant series; {have} selected.
一笔是一个合约从开仓到全部平掉的一次持仓，不论分几次成交；盈亏是卖出所得减买入所: A trade is one contract's position from its opening until all of it is closed, in however many fills; its profit is what the sells brought in less what the buys cost, times the contract multiplier, before fees. A position still open at the end is no trade, and when a dominant series rolls, the old month and the new are a trade each.
期限结构只在主力连续上评价：请去掉单个合约，只保留主力连续。: The term structure is evaluated on dominant series alone: remove the single contracts and keep the dominant series.
所选主力连续里有的没有期限结构数据：主力月份之后还需要有已下载日线的月份，才能比: A selected dominant series has no term structure: a month after the dominant one must have downloaded daily data for the two to be compared.
期限结构 · 每个交易日开始时已知的年化近远月价差：前一交易日主力月份的结算价: Term structure · the annualised spread known when a trading day begins: the dominant month's settlement on the day before over that of the later month with the largest open interest that day, less one, times 12 over the delivery months between them; averaged over the lookback window. Only trading days that allow the comparison are evaluated.
期限结构只使用前一交易日已有的结算价，留出段可使用此前历史预热。未来标签不进入因: The term structure uses only settlements already known the day before, and the holdout may warm up on earlier history. Future labels never enter the factor, and labels that cross the boundary are left out. A holdout evaluation needs its parameters fixed beforehand; tuning after looking at the holdout repeatedly proves nothing out of sample.
有期限结构的交易日: Trading days with a term structure
窗口里可以用逗号填多个值，所有组合各成一个候选策略，最多 32 个；规则用不了的: A window may hold several comma-separated values; every combination is a candidate strategy, up to 32, leaving out those the rule cannot work with. Several candidates are compared in one of two ways. Holdout: they are compared on the trading days before the holdout alone, and the one with the highest Sharpe ratio is replayed over every day. Rolling: each round compares them over a stretch of training days, the account follows that round's highest Sharpe ratio over the validation days after, and everything moves on by one round.
